elements.description:
Renders a model's UI spec – tables, charts, metrics, forms, callouts, text – as the library's own elements, with
text for anything it can't draw.

properties.name: spec
properties.description: The spec: { blocks }, a list of blocks or one block – or the model's JSON text, which may still be arriving

properties.name: streaming
properties.description: The spec text is still arriving: blocks show as they close, the one being written is a placeholder

properties.name: showIssues
properties.description: Show why a block fell back to text, under it – for development and evaluation, not for end users

properties.name: headingLevel
properties.description: The heading level of text headings, group and form titles (2–6); the tables' own titles stay h3

properties.name: issues
properties.description: What fell back to text, and why, by JSON Pointer path

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-action
events.description: A form was submitted or an action pressed ({ kind: "submit" | "action", action, block, values? })

events.name: tc-spec-check
events.description: The spec settled (not streaming) and what fell back to text changed ({ issues })

props.name: onAction
props.description: Called when a form is submitted (with its values) or an action button is pressed

props.name: onSpecCheck
props.description: Called once the spec settles with the blocks that fell back to text, and why
